inicio.kicker: Course · step 2 of the From chat to agent course · 8 lessons
inicio.titulo: Your Jarvis: an assistant with the memory and personality you define
inicio.lead: You learn the seven parts of an AI assistant, write who it is in four text files, ask a coding agent to build the core with tests, and connect it to Telegram. No programming skills needed: you decide, the agent builds, and the tests confirm it works.
inicio.capa_alt: Dark desk with a phone open to a conversation, a laptop with a terminal, and a notebook: the personal assistant you built.
inicio.aulas_sub: This is the deep dive for step 2. The overview of all four steps is in the From chat to agent course.

itens: Anyone who has completed step 1 (terminal, folders, and .env) and wants their own assistant, not a chat website.
Anyone who wants to understand what’s inside an agent before trusting it with their routine.
Anyone who doesn’t code but is willing to ask a coding agent and check its work with tests.

blocos.t: What you’ll be able to do
itens: Explain the seven parts of an agent and where each one lives in INTELECTO.
Write the SOUL, AGENTS, USER, and MEMORY files for your assistant.
Build the core with Claude Code or Codex and verify it with tests.
Connect it to Telegram with only one owner, choose its brain using your own numbers, and follow a routine for a week.
